answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 24475 Country: India Title: Is working in bank is allowed according to Islam? Question: Is working in bank is allowed according to islam Answer ID: 24475 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1479/1151/B=1431) If you have to record interest-based calculation, then it is not lawful. A Muslim should avoid it. However, the job of peon or guard is allowable. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
